reviews.title: Major bugs in last week.
reviews.text:
TikTok Studio has become basically unusable for me over the last few days. The app will open and the Home screen/dashboard loads, but anytime I try to open other sections of the app, I get the loading screen and then the entire app crashes and kicks me out. I reopen it, try again, and the same thing happens over and over.

I have already completely shut down and restarted my iPhone, tried both cellular data and Wi-Fi, and nothing has changed. My regular TikTok app works normally, so this appears to be specific to the TikTok Studio app.

As a creator, I rely on Studio to access my scheduled content and creator tools, so having the app repeatedly crash makes it impossible to use those features. Please fix the stability issues with the iOS app.

reviews.title: Artist Account Banned 4 Weeks Ago
reviews.text:
I am an independent artist and right before the release of my song, my account was suddenly banned while I was scrolling. I never received a violation before, and when I got the notification of the ban it said it was an “impersonation violation.” This is incorrect as it is my own account and I also use the same handle for all of my social media accounts. I immediately appealed. It’s now been 4 weeks, and I have followed the recommended process, submitted another appeal but it’s now been 4 Weeks without any update beyond automated replies. 
I am unable to reach a real person, and my case has not been reviewed. 

As an independent artist, this has greatly impacted my ability to promote my new release. My music has been delivered to that account by my distributor and I can’t post about it!
Is there any way someone from your team can help me get this resolved? I would really appreciate it. Again, I have already submitted 2 appeals.

reviews.title: tags
reviews.text: i am a creator on tiktok, i make art content, post my art, im not big but i have a decent community that ive built. recently, as in the past few months, tiktok has made it so you can only add 5 hashtags to your videos. this really irked me, as i am someone who adds many hashtags so i can be seen by a larger audience. i found out that you could get around this by using tiktok studio. i downloaded it, and found it to be really enjoyable. it offered multiple features that were extremely useful such as detailed analytics, and letting me schedule my posts (definitely my favorite). today, i opened the app, created a post, and went to tag it. now, on tiktok studio, i can only add five tags. i really feel like this is just a terrible restriction?? how is it helping anyone? the only thing it does is make it harder to properly categorize your content, and push it out to more people. do better.
